Typed claude in terminal. Claude Code era begins. No turning back.

Apr 2026
Codex shows up. Now there are two of them, reviewing each other's code while I watch. By month-end the roster peaks at five bots: AntiBot · 睿智 · AWS-bot · 小试AI · LanceDB Test.
Codex 入场。现在有两个了，它俩互相 review 代码，我在旁边围观。月底阵容达到巅峰，5 个 Bot 同时在跑：AntiBot · 睿智 · AWS-bot · 小试AI · LanceDB Test。
May 2026

An "E-twin" — a digital me on Telegram. Eerie but useful. Then the Hermes consolidation: 睿智 and 小试AI merge into Anti. Five bots become three, same throughput, half the moving parts. (小试AI stays on as a pen name. It'll outlive us all anyway.)

Jul 2026
The EC2 goes. Keeping a server alive just to run cron stopped making sense. Three become two.
EC2 退役了。为了跑几个 cron 单养一台服务器，实在不划算。3 个变成 2 个。
Sep 2026

The OpenClaw chapter closes on the 14th; my OpenClaw repos are archived as a record. A week later Claude Code and Codex leave my Telegram bridges for the official Remote Control. Same month, the playground opens: things built purely for fun.
14 号，OpenClaw 这一章合上了，我自己的 OpenClaw 相关仓库归档留作记录。一周后 Claude Code 和 Codex 也从 Telegram 桥上撤下，改走官方远程。同月 playground 开张：专门放纯粹因为好玩才做的东西。
Oct 2026
Grok pulls up a chair at the review table. Codex nearly left mid-month, then stayed. My prompt folder grows up into a real system with a front desk and a bouncer (see the Arsenal).
Grok 也搬了把椅子，坐上了互审桌。Codex 月中差点走人，最后留下了。我的提示词文件夹长大成了一套正经系统，有前台、有保安（见弹药库）。
Nov 2026

A month of Codex batch images eats the VPN's monthly traffic, so pictures move to ChatGPT on the web — which is now its only job; judgement calls go to AGY. Grok's subscription runs out in December, so it's quietly packing up its chair.

arsenal_rules: File by purpose, not by style.
Style is the prompt's own business; purpose is how I'll look for it at 11 p.m.
按用途归档，不按风格归档。
风格是提示词自己的事，用途才是我晚上 11 点找它的路。
One recipe, one copy.
Two copies drift. They always drift.
一份配方只存一份。
两份必漂移，从来没有例外。
"All duplicates" is a perfectly good result.
One batch: 117 volumes in, 111 bounced. The bouncer has standards and no quota.
「全部撞重」是完全正常的结果。
有一批送进来 117 卷，被拦下 111 卷。保安有标准，没有 KPI。
Tested or not, say so.
194 of the 238 folders state their test status in writing, and "not test-generated yet" is a perfectly respectable answer. Vibes are not evidence.
测没测过，写明白。
238 个目录里有 194 个白纸黑字写了实测状态，「还没生图实测」是一个很体面的答案。感觉不算证据。
No credits, no shelf.
Every recipe carries five header lines: author, source post, official repo, date collected, upstream commit and license.
没署名，不上架。
每份配方带五行抬头：作者、原帖出处、官方仓、收录日期、上游 commit 和许可证。
